bootstrap.interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles; conditional on fitted models and frozen sample

grouping: Remove non-ASCII alphanumeric characters from uppercase recorded borrower name/state/ZIP; SHA256 of pipe-joined values. Earliest eligible funded loan per key; ties by source record ID. Imperfect identity heuristic.
isotonic: Fit on calibration labels only; raw input grid 6 decimal places; final scores 10 decimal places; out-of-bounds clip.
limitations: Retrospective final-snapshot funding-cohort validation; first-publication times and historical feature revisions are absent. Do not invent available_at.
Recorded SBA charge-off is not 180-day delinquency, lifetime default, recoveries or prevented loss.
US historical SBA lending is not current Chinese retail credit.
Only about 90 held-out events; sampling, identity matching and missing-rate shifts restrict inference.
A hash binds bytes, not truth or independent adoption. No deployment, causal, savings or external-use claim.
preprocessing: Median imputation with missing indicators, scaling and one-hot categories fit on train only; unknown categories ignored.
sampling: Per stage, lowest SHA256(original file SHA256 + colon + one-based logical row ordinal); no outcome-based sampling. Stage windows and sample sizes were fixed before fitting.
target_definition: Recorded ChargeOffDate from FirstDisbursementDate through inclusive 24-month anniversary; clamp leap-day month ends. Later lifetime charge-offs are negative for this horizon. CHGOFF without a date is excluded, never a negative.
